The deferred ontology/shape-coupled WO-03 content is not claimed; the xaas side of G6/G8 (RecipeWorker, SemanticCrown.drive/1, real sealed receipts) is not exercised here: the sealed XaaS receipt in the G8 tests is contract-shaped input data

findings: TransitionLog event_digest is SemanticJira.digest/1, which elides definition_digest/receipt_digest/transition_digest: fetch/1 cannot detect tampering of those event fields, and two receipts for the same from->to transition on the same snapshot collapse to one event (already_recorded). Successor: digest events with digest_exact/1 plus a ledger-format version.
Descriptor.dependency/3 binds upstream receipt_digest from the event, whose own digest does not cover receipt_digest (same root cause as above).
A stale <ledger>.ndjson.lock left by a crashed writer blocks appends after 500 x 10 ms with {:ledger_locked, lock}; no stale-lock recovery.

Court finding (fixed in 95069e2): receipt_from_xaas digest/shape refusals were bare atoms and crashed Cli.xaas_receipt with CaseClauseError; failure was fail-closed (no reconciler receipt written) and predated FRI-T6 (present in preserve/v26.9.22/wo-03-wip descriptor.ex:512/515).
